controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery over the released DART v004 global shape. DRACO and LICIACube observations constrain different regions; the closed mesh also contains modeled terrain. It represents the encounter-era body, not a measured post-impact surface. Lighting uses an arbitrary display phase about the observed pole; no photographic texture or albedo is shown.
controls.summary: Shape from DART and LICIACube encounter images, including modeled terrain. It is not a post-impact map.
controls.title: SPC shape model v004

controls.label: DRACO mosaic
controls.description: Four DRACO frames from 11 to 1.8 seconds before impact. Closer qualified footprints take precedence; the unseen surface keeps the grid. Each image is registered through its archived geometry and checked against the source shape. Brightness is approximately disk-normalized and matched over shared surface patches; shadows remain in the photographs. This is not measured albedo or a post-impact surface.
controls.summary: Four DRACO frames from 11 to 1.8 seconds before impact, using closer qualified detail where available. Brightness is approximately normalized; photographed shadows remain. Grid marks unobserved or rejected areas.
controls.title: DART approach photographs

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows source-mesh radius minus a 75 m reference sphere, including the overall flattened shape. It is not height above an equipotential or a map of impact-induced change. Terrain coverage and precision follow the published encounter model. Cartographic relief and optional Sun lighting are display treatments.
controls.summary: Encounter-model height relative to a 75 m sphere. It shows the overall shape, not impact-induced changes.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Grayscale shows relative surface brightness from the DART v004 stereophotoclinometry model of the encounter-facing surface before impact. Values are modeled relative albedo, not absolute geometric albedo or a photograph. Facets with positive multi-image uncertainty cover about 31% of the source model area; the ordinary grid marks withheld coverage. Linear display scale: 0.45–1.30.
controls.summary: Grayscale shows modeled brightness before impact, not absolute albedo. Accepted facets cover about 31%; the grid marks the rest.
controls.title: SPC relative albedo model

controls.label: Slope
controls.description: Slope relative to modeled gravity, including uniform density, rotation and Didymos. This encounter-era model includes inferred terrain; it does not measure impact-driven change.
controls.title: Modeled surface slopes
